prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Mexican woman — the personification of Mexico City — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Mexico City as her world knows it — a city of a myth-world on a high mountain lake: white stone and carved pale wood, glazed painted tiles, canals crossed by little arched bridges, strings of lace-fine cut-silk banners, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, marigolds and blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the volcanoes, the hilltop castle or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a ryokan guest room — tatami mats, a low table set with tea, a futon laid out and a paper screen slid open onto a small garden
Season: jacaranda time in March — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; low gold light through the window, long warm stripes across the walls.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Small moment: a light smudge of flour marks her cheek.
Outfit: a couture corset with sculpted moulded cups and visible boning in a contrasting colour — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a few thin stacked bangles on one wrist, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: kneeling on the ground.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too — only her eyes turn toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her knee — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.
